To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the French disclosure regulations and the payment method affect the offer premiums.

(1) disclosure rules increase takeover premiums, (2) the impact of the payment methods (all-cash versus all-stock) on premiums is not limited to public tender offers, (3) the impact of disclosure rules on premiums is not restricted to public tender offers but also applies to private tender offers, and (4) disclosure rules do not affect the option value component of the takeover premium.

(1) disclosure regulations increase the total takeover premium and the premium component reflecting the value of information, (2) the payment method does not affect the value of the information component but does affect the value of control, and (3) the value of control is higher in public tender offers than in private offers and is also higher in all-cash offers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of information disclosure and the payment method on takeover premiums.
the impact of information disclosure on the premium paid in public tender offers.
the impact on the takeover premium of two institutional changes: disclosure regulations and the method of payment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
disclosure requirements and the method of payment are two separate determinants of the takeover premium.

the French experience is consistent with the hypothesis that the disclosure rules are effective in reducing the costs of tender offer information acquisition, while the payment method has a more direct impact on the value of the tender offer premium.
information disclosure and payment method are important determinants of the premium paid in a takeover.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the French takeover regulations, by increasing the information available to bidders and by reducing the costs of making all-cash offers, have increased the premium offered to shareholders.
information disclosure and the payment method are substitutes for each other, and that both are complements for a tender offer.
information disclosure rules and the payment method are important determinants of takeover premiums, and that the impact is more pronounced in public than in privately negotiated offers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
disclosure requirements are not the main determinant of the takeover premium.
disclosure rules and the payment method have a strong effect on offer premiums.
the disclosure of information about target firm performance is not the only factor influencing takeover premiums.
